name: Syslog (RFC 5424)
description: Receive events in RFC 5424 syslog format via HTTP relay

setup_guide.title: Forward syslog via HTTP relay
steps: Install a syslog-to-HTTP forwarder (rsyslog omhttp, syslog-ng http(), or Vector)
Configure the output destination to the Hakuna webhook URL below
Set Content-Type to text/plain and include the Bearer token
Each POST body should contain one RFC 5424 syslog line

sample_payload: <134>1 2024-03-15T14:30:00Z firewall-01 sshd 12345 - - Failed password for user admin from 192.168.1.100 port 22 ssh2
